hazards.evidence: A black hair dryer sits on the vanity countertop right next to the sink basin, with its cord dangling over the counter edge. It appears to be plugged in, creating a risk of electrocution or burns if it is misused or knocked into water.

A white raised toilet seat sits on a white toilet bowl in front of a white tub, giving very low color contrast. This makes it hard for a person with dementia to see and locate the seat, which increases the risk of falls and toileting accidents.
